evidence.source: Phase 1 audit of real HTTP responses from one HG6145F1 gateway; sensitive values redacted.
notes: Endpoint and field names were observed on the physical device.
Status remains 'observed', not 'verified', because full profile compatibility still requires normalized-output comparison on that device.
No credential values, phone numbers, public IPs, or serial numbers are stored here.

rules.evidence: get_device_name returned this ModelName on the observed gateway; a model string alone is not firmware-unique.

endpoints.description: Returns acsRandom and sessionid used by the FiberHome AES challenge.
Submits the encrypted password and returns login_result.
Explicit logout; role is derived from get_login_user.
Device identity, system, and optical fields.
Pre-auth model name used for identification.
Current login role, used to form the logout request.
Voice port, number, and registration status.

limitations: Only fields observed on one HG6145F1 are described here.
Speed testing is local to the host and is not provided by this connector.
IPv6 and USB dongle payloads are collected by the legacy path but not yet mapped to universal metrics or collections.
Compatibility must be confirmed against the physical device before this profile replaces hardcoded logic.

evidence.source: Observed on a local Huawei HG8145X6-10 web management interface; sensitive values redacted from fixtures.
notes: Authentication uses Huawei ASP token endpoint and login.cgi form POST with base64 password and X_HW_Token.
Metrics are extracted from authenticated ASP/HTML pages using read-only GET requests.
Status remains 'observed'; physical-device compatibility requires normalized comparison on the device.

rules.evidence: Root page contains the device model string on observed Huawei firmware.

endpoints.description: Pre-auth root page used for identification.
Huawei login form; success response redirects to index.asp.
WLAN info page with SSID/radio configuration.

limitations: WAN metrics are mapped from authenticated getwanlist.asp PPP/IP constructor rows; only fields present in the active Internet row are exposed.
VoIP phone number is unavailable: observed stLine exposes status/call state/register error only; no reliable phone number or SIP secrets are extracted.
Wi-Fi is mapped only as SSID collection consumed by dashboard (name/active); passwords/PSKs/secrets are never extracted.
